clarification.mapping_rule: Map the verbatim MCWB Industry value through the historical official NSE Indices classification structure applicable at the ranking cutoff; unresolved mappings fail rather than fall back or use fuzzy matching.

discovery.observed_issue: The blind implementation passed the MCWB Industry field directly into the engines as sector, producing 27, 29, 28, and 30 Baseline groups.
discovery.reason: Predictor-only feasibility inspection showed that the preregistered sector-date metric requires the higher official NSE Indices Sector tier rather than the more granular MCWB Industry labels.
